# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_FILTER9_RELAXED

**Filed:** 2026-07-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Relaxing the body shape requirement in filter 9 for BEARISH_REJECTION (removing the condition that the bar's body must be in the lower 40% of the range) will increase trade count by allowing entries on bearish bars with longer upper wicks, while maintaining the core conditions of close < open, close < Fast EMA, and volume ≥ 1.3×20-bar average. We hypothesize this will capture additional bearish momentum entries without significantly degrading average P&L per trade, as the retained filters still require bearish close, EMA alignment, and elevated volume.

## Mechanism

Current filter 9 logic:  
`close < open AND close < fast_ema AND vol >= 1.3 * vol_20bar_avg AND (body_pct_lower <= 0.4)`  
where `body_pct_lower = (close - low) / (high - low)` (proportion of bar body in lower 40%).

Proposed filter 9 logic:  
`close < open AND close < fast_ema AND vol >= 1.3 * vol_20bar_avg`

Entry trigger remains: when filter 9 fires, enter BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (PUT) at next bar open. Exit logic unchanged: primary chart stop (rejected level + $0.50 buffer), TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3), runner with breakeven stop after TP1, chandelier profit-lock, and 15:50 ET time stop.
